title: Staff Login
summary: A clinic's staff portal has no self-service signup. Get into the administrator's account anyway.
objectives: Find out how the login form behaves with unexpected input
Sign in as an administrator without a password
Recover the payroll export key from the admin note
learningOutcomes: Identify SQL injection from error messages
Bypass a login by changing query logic
Fix the flaw with parameterized queries

hints.bodyMd: Try a single quote in the username field and read what comes back.
If you can end the string early, you can also comment out the password check. SQLite comments start with two dashes.
